title: Days in Levels – level 3
paragraphs: We have a special website for you. We write short stories about famous moments in history. The stories are written in three levels. You can learn English at your level when you read these stories.
Level 1 is easy. It is for beginners. Level 2 is for pre-intermediate students. Level 3 is for intermediate students.
You can find the stories at www.daysinlevels.com.
How can we improve Days in Levels?
What famous days do you want us to write about?
Please, write your answers in the Comments section.
We hope you will enjoy reading Days in Levels.
